# ADR-3225: AWS logging: CloudTrail multi-region required key for org 1

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Partial trails miss regional attacker activity.

## Decision

Organizations SHALL enable a CloudTrail multi-region required key for org 1 (AWS-logging-1).

## Consequences

Org trails bind to a security Log Archive account.
